trofeos.descripcion: Congratulations! You're Vinewood's biggest star!
trofeos.pista: Unlocks automatically upon earning all other GTA V trophies, including the GTA Online ones.

trofeos.descripcion: Earn any 70 Gold Medals on Missions, Strangers and Freaks.
trofeos.pista: Every main mission and Strangers and Freaks mission has gold objectives; replay them from the pause menu to earn them.

trofeos.descripcion: Attain 100% Game Completion.
trofeos.pista: Requires main missions, hobbies and pastimes, stunt jumps, 50 spaceship parts and the required collectibles.

trofeos.descripcion: GTA Online: Reach Rank 100.
trofeos.pista: Combine all kinds of activities (heists, races, contact missions) to rank up.

trofeos.descripcion: Explore all of Los Santos and Blaine County.
trofeos.pista: You need to uncover roughly 95% of the game's total map.

trofeos.nombre: To Live or Die in Los Santos
trofeos.descripcion: Completed the final mission.
trofeos.pista: Earned upon finishing the final story mission. Story-related.

trofeos.descripcion: Complete your path to enlightenment... or not.
trofeos.pista: Complete the entire Epsilon Program Strangers and Freaks mission line with Michael.

trofeos.descripcion: GTA Online: Reach Rank 50.
trofeos.pista: Rank up by taking part in all kinds of GTA Online activities.

trofeos.descripcion: GTA Online: Earn 30 Platinum Awards.
trofeos.pista: Platinum Awards are earned by completing in-game challenges across various categories (combat, racing, heists...).

trofeos.descripcion: You repo'd a car and raced it through the heart of a sun-soaked metropolis.
trofeos.pista: Story-related: unlocks during Franklin's opening missions.

trofeos.descripcion: With friends like this who needs enemies?
trofeos.pista: Story-related.

trofeos.descripcion: It's time for a little getaway.
trofeos.pista: Story-related.

trofeos.descripcion: You have uncovered the truth about Brad.
trofeos.pista: Story-related.

trofeos.descripcion: You cleaned out Vangelico to pay back Martin Madrazo.
trofeos.pista: Story-related: earned after completing The Jewel Store Job.

trofeos.descripcion: You stole an experimental super weapon from Merryweather... and gave it back.
trofeos.pista: Story-related: earned after completing The Merryweather Heist.

trofeos.descripcion: You performed a classic blitz play.
trofeos.pista: Story-related: earned after completing Blitz Play.

trofeos.descripcion: You made a big impression at the Paleto Bay Chicken Festival.
trofeos.pista: Story-related: earned after completing The Paleto Score.

trofeos.descripcion: You recovered sensitive information from a highly defended federal building.
trofeos.pista: Story-related: earned after completing The Bureau Raid.

trofeos.descripcion: This ain't no dream no more.
trofeos.pista: Story-related: earned after completing The Big Score at the Union Depository.

trofeos.nombre: All's Fare in Love and War
trofeos.descripcion: Purchase Downtown Cab Co. and complete a private fare.
trofeos.pista: Purchase Downtown Cab Co. with Franklin for $200,000 and complete a VIP private fare.

trofeos.descripcion: Purchase McKenzie Field Hangar and win the arms race.
trofeos.pista: Purchase the airfield with Trevor and complete all 5 ground trafficking missions and 5 air trafficking missions.

trofeos.descripcion: Attain a gold medal in all applicable hobbies and pastimes.
trofeos.pista: Earn at least one Gold Medal in Shooting Range, Street Races, Sea Races, Off-Road Races, Triathlon and Flight School.

trofeos.descripcion: Collect and return all spaceship parts.
trofeos.pista: Collect all 50 Spaceship Parts and complete Omega's final Strangers and Freaks mission.

trofeos.descripcion: Solve the mystery of Leonora Johnson.
trofeos.pista: Collect all 50 Letter Scraps and complete Dreyfuss's Strangers and Freaks mission.

trofeos.descripcion: Purchase the old dock and collect all nuclear waste.
trofeos.pista: Purchase Sonar Collections Dock and collect all 30 nuclear waste barrels around the ocean floor.

trofeos.descripcion: Complete all Rampages.
trofeos.pista: Complete all 5 of Trevor's Rampages across San Andreas.

trofeos.descripcion: Complete all Stunt Jumps.
trofeos.pista: Successfully land all 50 unique Stunt Jumps across the map.

trofeos.descripcion: Survive 3 minutes on at least a 3 star Wanted Level with all three characters together off mission.
trofeos.pista: Call the other two protagonists to hang out together, trigger a 3-star wanted level (e.g. at the airport) and survive for 3 minutes.

trofeos.descripcion: You're gonna need a bigger boat...
trofeos.pista: Swim out into deep ocean waters and let a shark attack and kill you.

trofeos.descripcion: Deliver an unsuspecting victim to the Altruist Cult.
trofeos.pista: As Trevor, pick up a random event passenger (such as a hitchhiker) and drive them to the Altruist Cult camp.

trofeos.descripcion: Spend a total of $200 million across all three characters.
trofeos.pista: Quick trick: repeatedly buy and immediately sell shares on the stock market until your cumulative spending reaches $200M.

trofeos.descripcion: Make a profit over your total investments in the stock market.
trofeos.pista: Buy shares on LCN or BAWSAQ and sell them at a net profit; Lester's assassination missions are the best opportunity.

trofeos.descripcion: Fully mod a weapon.
trofeos.pista: Purchase every available attachment and tint for a single weapon at Ammu-Nation.

trofeos.descripcion: Deliver a bail bond target alive.
trofeos.pista: Complete one of Maude's bail bond missions with Trevor by capturing the target alive instead of killing them.

trofeos.descripcion: Fully mod a vehicle.
trofeos.pista: Purchase modifications in every available category for a vehicle at Los Santos Customs.

trofeos.descripcion: Complete all Under the Bridge and Knife Flight challenges.
trofeos.pista: Complete all 50 Under the Bridge flights and all 15 Knife Flights between downtown skyscrapers.

trofeos.descripcion: You played GTA V in first person mode for 15 hours.
trofeos.pista: Available on Enhanced editions (PS4, Xbox One, PS5, Xbox Series, PC). Switch camera to first-person view and accumulate 15 hours.

trofeos.descripcion: GTA Online: Complete the Introduction.
trofeos.pista: Create your character, watch the airport intro and complete the opening race and job with Lamar.

trofeos.descripcion: GTA Online: Reach Rank 25.
trofeos.pista: Rank up by completing jobs and activities in GTA Online.

trofeos.descripcion: GTA Online: Obtain first place in all competitive game types.
trofeos.pista: Win at least once in every competitive mode (Deathmatches, Races, Survival, Parachuting, Darts, Tennis, Golf, Shooting Range...).

trofeos.descripcion: GTA Online: Use custom vehicles to win 5 races.
trofeos.pista: Modify a personal vehicle and win 5 GTA Online races with Custom Vehicles enabled.

trofeos.descripcion: GTA Online: Complete all 10 waves of a Survival.
trofeos.pista: Survival mode unlocks at Rank 15; survive all 10 enemy waves.

trofeos.descripcion: GTA Online: Direct a driver to 1st place as co-driver in Rally Mode.
trofeos.pista: Play as the co-driver in a Rally race (requires 4 players) and guide your driver to victory.

trofeos.descripcion: GTA Online: Survive for a day with a Bounty on your head.
trofeos.pista: Survive for one full in-game day (48 real-time minutes) in free roam while a bounty is active on you.

trofeos.descripcion: GTA Online: Finish a Gang Attack without dying and kill at least 10 enemies.
trofeos.pista: Clear a red Gang Attack circle in free roam without dying while getting at least 10 kills.

trofeos.descripcion: GTA Online: Hold up all 20 Stores.
trofeos.pista: Rob all 20 convenience and liquor stores marked with a basket icon across the map.

trofeos.descripcion: GTA Online: Participate in everything Los Santos has to offer.
trofeos.pista: Complete a haircut, tattoo, clothes purchase, private dance, shooting range, darts, golf, tennis, arm wrestling and hold up a store.

trofeos.descripcion: GTA Online: Complete a Job as a member of a Crew.
trofeos.pista: Join a Rockstar Social Club Crew and complete a job alongside at least one Crew member.

trofeos.descripcion: GTA Online: Kill the thief that mugged you.
trofeos.pista: After another player calls Lamar to send a Mugger after you (unlocked at Rank 50), chase and kill the mugger to recover your cash.

trofeos.descripcion: GTA Online: Call for a Backup Helicopter for the first time.
trofeos.pista: Reach Rank 20 and call Merryweather on your cell phone to request a Backup Helicopter.

trofeos.descripcion: GTA Online: Own an Apartment, Garage and an Insured Vehicle.
trofeos.pista: Purchase a high-end or medium apartment that includes a garage via Dynasty 8 and insure a personal vehicle.
